shortDescription: Get best-practice objects facts on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: blade
options.description: Returns all the relevant Best Practices of the selected Software Blades. When empty will return all the Best Practices.

options.name: defined_by
options.description: Returns all the relevant Best Practices of the selected type.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: gateway_name
options.description: Returns all the relevant Best Practices of the selected Security Gateway object.

options.name: limit
options.description: The maximal number of returned results. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects. Valid values are between 1 and 500.

options.name: name
options.description: Best Practice Name. This parameter is relevant only for getting a specific object.

options.name: offset
options.description: Number of the results to initially skip. This parameter is relevant only for getting few objects.

options.name: show_only_local_domain
options.description: Indicates whether the query should return only objects from the current local domain. This parameter is only valid for local domain.

options.name: show_regulations
options.description: Show the applicable regulations of the Best Practice.

options.name: status
options.description: Returns all the relevant best practices with the selected statuses. When empty will return all best practices.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.
